caseNameFull: Arthur J. LOMAX v. Christina ORTIZ-MARQUEZ

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit granted limited to the following question: Does a dismissal without prejudice for failure to state a claim count as a strike under 28 U.S.C. § 1915(g) ?
